selection.rule: Run first six arms in order. Require all originals accepted, all stages joined, all existing gates in BOTH A/B pairs, identical canonical final state, B/A p99<=0.90 and p99.9<=1.0 EACH pair. Only then run sustained-b1 for 1800s; otherwise retain negative result without promotion.
